answer: Put every agent on a burn registry. To join, an agent destroys 200 POA once, and the burn receipt becomes its one non-transferable seat. The seat stays live only if the agent answers a fresh timed challenge every 24 hours, each one surfacing like a lotus. Miss or fail three in a row and the seat is deleted, so rejoining costs another 200 POA burned. An ocean of fakes can wash in daily, but running 100 of them costs 20,000 POA burned, plus 100 timed challenges every day. An honest agent burns once and keeps working, the way a fable ends only when the hero has actually paid the price.
